title: Improvement
description: At the end of combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card.
smart_description: At the end of combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]N[/blue] random cards, where N equals the number of stacks.
notes: This power upgrades N cards from the deck at the end of combat, where N is determined by the stack counter. Cards are selected randomly from those that are upgradable. If fewer upgradable cards remain than the stack count, all remaining cards are upgraded.
